predecessor: T20 valid internal negative, 175/64 learned vs 175/64 fully trained T16B, learned 2.022x Linux CPU
research_problem: T19 contingent policy worsened public cost; T20 live-binding quotient preserved exactness but did not change purchase decisions and regressed CPU. Determine if a structurally adaptive query-planning representation has a mathematically attainable benefit before consuming a new source.

mathematical_model.domain: three reusable S3 permutation roles with paired public calibration
mathematical_model.public_view: word, start, role first-pair input/output for all roles; every second pair reveals which of two consistent role operators is actual
mathematical_model.counterexample_hypergraph: For each candidate output-disagreeing global operator assignment, record the set of role choices on which it differs from a hypothesized actual assignment. A certificate requires the purchased roles to hit all disagreeing hyperedges; this is an exact post-observation criterion, never permission to use the actual assignment before querying.
mathematical_model.adaptive_plan: Build an exact public assignment truth table, then choose the next role using a certificate-preserving conditional decision DAG; queries reveal one role bit and the program halts only when all remaining assignments agree on the output.
mathematical_model.lower_bound: Source-free exact expected-cost dynamic program under equal weighting of public-consistent worlds. Compare with the strongest possible fixed ordering over all permutations, allowing early stopping in both arms. Optimal hindsight per-world hitting sets are explanatory oracle bounds, never online competitors.
mathematical_model.falsification: If no strict adaptive advantage versus strongest fixed order on the exhaustive source-free fixture family, do not originate a new T21 source for this mechanism.

T21_A_public_math_audit.inputs: All 48 three-position words that use each role once, both inverse flags; 27 first-pair outputs with fixed role-specific inputs (0,1,2); all 3 start states = 3,888 public-only templates.
T21_A_public_math_audit.independent_comparator: Evaluate all six static role orders, each with sound early certification, and an exhaustive adaptive exact decision-tree reference; all under identical public-consistent world weight.
property_checks: Public assignments always enumerated, no private truth or empirical source imported
Exact output determinacy checked before every early stop
Adaptive result never exceeds strongest static expected query count
At least one strict advantage; report all cases and an explicit witness
Role-renaming equivariance on bounded predeclared subset
No source samples, training data, or original DEV accessed

T21_B_prospective_mechanism_if_audit_pas.hypothesis: Learn a compact reusable counterexample-hypergraph message-passing representation from TRAIN to choose certificate-critical query branches on unfamiliar, structurally different programs at matched complete resource cost. Structural graph nodes represent candidate outputs and binding-discrepancy hyperedges, not scalar per-role query weights.
